name: Cross-connect
simple: A short glass cable inside one building that joins two companies' boxes.
technical: A cross-connect: a single-mode fibre pair patched through the data centre's meet-me room between two tenants' ports, usually 10–100G Ethernet.

2010.technical: A cross-connect: a single-mode fibre pair patched through the data centre's meet-me room between two tenants' ports, usually 1–10G Ethernet; the first 100G ports came in 2010.
